findings.location: Paragraph beginning “We have already seen how sin separates us…”
findings.source_quote: If we are left to continue in our sin, what has Jesus done for us?
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with: «Hvis vi får fortsette å leve i synden vår, hva har Jesus da gjort for oss?»
findings.translation_quote: Hvis vi må fortsette å leve i synden vår, hva har Jesus da gjort for oss?

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “When we call out to God for salvation…”
findings.source_quote: we know we need to be saved; converted.

findings.translation_quote: vi trenger å bli frelst; omvendt.
